name: Pimple patches
summary: Hydrocolloid protects the spot, absorbs drainage, stops you picking.
lead: Pimple patches are small adhesive stickers, usually made of hydrocolloid, that are placed over an individual blemish for several hours or overnight. Some versions add salicylic acid or tiny microneedles. They are sold at roughly $5 to $15 per pack and are used to flatten whiteheads and to protect spots from picking.

name: Silicone scar sheets
summary: Genuinely improves some raised scars with consistent wear.
lead: Silicone scar sheets are adhesive, reusable sheets of medical-grade silicone gel that are worn over a healed scar for much of the day over weeks to months. They are used mainly for raised hypertrophic scars and keloids and are sometimes applied after surgery or acne. Consumer packs are typically priced at about $10 to $30.

name: Under-eye cooling mask
summary: Temporarily shrinks morning puffiness.
lead: An under-eye cooling mask is a reusable gel or cold-pack patch worn over the lower eyelids and cheeks for a few minutes, typically after sleep or a late night, with the aim of reducing the look of puffy eyes. It is a form of local cryotherapy, the therapeutic use of low temperatures, which is more widely used for sprains, muscle soreness and swelling after surgery or soft tissue injury.

name: High-frequency wand
summary: Purple lightning, weak evidence.
lead: A high-frequency wand is a handheld skincare device that passes a low-current, high-voltage, high-frequency alternating current through a gas-filled glass electrode held close to the skin, producing a violet glow and a faint ozone smell. It is marketed for acne, pores, congestion and anti-aging and descends from the electrotherapy devices of the late nineteenth century, often called d'Arsonval or violet-ray devices.

name: Face slimming strap
summary: Compression does not melt fat or move bone. Full stop.
lead: A face slimming strap is an elastic band worn under the chin and over the head or ears to compress the lower face and neck. It is marketed for reducing the look of a double chin and defining the jawline and is sold mainly through online marketplaces and social media. Similar straps, called chin straps, are also used in medical settings, for example to keep the mouth closed during positive airway pressure therapy.

name: Nose reshaping clip
summary: Adult cartilage does not care about a clothespin.
lead: A nose reshaping clip, also sold as a nose shaper, lifter or slimmer, is a soft plastic or silicone device that is clipped or fitted onto the nose and worn for periods of time. It is marketed as a non-surgical way to lift the tip, narrow the bridge or straighten the nose.

name: Facial lifting tape
summary: Physically pulls skin into place. Works exactly until you take it off.
lead: Facial lifting tape consists of adhesive strips or invisible patches that are stuck to the cheeks, jawline or temples and pulled backward, usually hidden under hair or clothing, to temporarily tighten sagging skin. The practice has a long history in photography, film and event styling.

name: Lip plumping device
summary: Suction swelling for a few hours. Bruising risk if you get greedy.
lead: A lip plumping device is a small cup or suction tool placed over the lips to draw blood and fluid into the tissue and produce temporary swelling. Some versions add vibration or warmth. It is promoted as a do-it-yourself alternative to lip filler that gives a fuller look for a short time. Wikipedia lists suction pumps among the non-surgical alternatives to lip augmentation, describing them as devices that use vacuum to raise pressure in the lips and cause temporary swelling.

name: Facial exerciser
summary: Cheek/smile trainers — weak evidence for any aesthetic outcome.
lead: Facial exercisers are small silicone or resistance devices held in the mouth or against the cheeks to work the smile, cheek and jaw muscles. They are sold alongside facial yoga routines and marketed for fuller cheeks, less sagging and a more youthful or more defined face. The underlying idea is that repeated contraction against resistance may strengthen or enlarge facial muscles, as strength training does elsewhere in the body.

name: Laser hair-growth cap
summary: FDA-cleared low-level light devices measurably improve density in pattern hair loss.
lead: A laser hair-growth cap is a wearable helmet- or cap-style device containing an array of low-power red-light laser diodes or LEDs, worn for a set number of minutes on a regular schedule to treat thinning hair. It applies low-level laser (light) therapy, also called photobiomodulation, to the scalp and is sold as a drug-free option for androgenetic alopecia (pattern hair loss), alone or alongside minoxidil or finasteride.
claims: Laser caps can regrow or thicken hair
A laser cap adds benefit on top of finasteride
Results are as good as drugs

name: Laser comb
summary: Same photobiomodulation idea, cheaper and slower to use.
lead: A laser comb is a handheld hair-growth device with a row of teeth that part the hair while low-power red laser light is directed at the scalp. It applies the technique known as low-level laser therapy (LLLT) or photobiomodulation, and is marketed for androgenetic alopecia (pattern hair loss). The best-known model, the HairMax LaserComb, has been described in the dermatology literature as FDA-cleared for this indication .
claims: Laser combs regrow or thicken hair in androgenetic alopecia
A comb gives the same benefit as a laser cap but needs more effort
Laser therapy is a useful add-on to minoxidil or finasteride

name: Scalp massager
summary: Feels incredible. Will not regrow hair.
lead: A scalp massager is a handheld tool used to rub or knead the scalp. The most common consumer form is a soft silicone brush with flexible nubs, often called a shampoo brush, used in the shower to lather shampoo and loosen flakes; powered vibrating versions and wire-style tickle devices also exist . Such tools are marketed for relaxation, scalp cleansing and, more contentiously, hair growth.
claims: Daily scalp massage thickens hair and can help regrowth
Massage boosts scalp blood flow, which feeds follicles
Scalp massage reduces stress and so supports hair health

name: Scalp microneedling roller
summary: Marketed to boost minoxidil response; home evidence is thin.
lead: A scalp microneedling roller, also called a derma roller, is a handheld barrel covered in short needles that is rolled across the scalp to make many tiny punctures. Consumer versions are sold with needle lengths of roughly 0.25 to 1.0 mm and are used in hair-loss communities alongside topical minoxidil.
claims: Dermarolling improves minoxidil results
A cheap home roller works like the clinic treatment

name: Hair fibers
summary: Instant density illusion. The single best cosmetic trick for thinning hair.
lead: Hair fibers, also called hair-building or concealing fibers, are small coloured strands, usually made from keratin or cotton, sold as a loose powder in a shaker or sprinkler. When shaken or dusted over thinning hair they cling to existing hairs and make them look thicker, which reduces the visible contrast between scalp and hair . Well-known brands include Toppik, Nanogen and Viviscal's fibers, and a published laboratory study analysed all three .
claims: Fibers instantly hide thinning without treating it
Fibers work anywhere on the scalp
Using fibers will be noticed or can be hidden from partners

name: Hairline concealer / powder
summary: Fills the hairline and part visually.
lead: Hairline concealers are tinted powders, sticks or cushion-style compacts brushed or dabbed onto the hairline, part and thinning areas to reduce the contrast between scalp and hair. They are a cosmetic camouflage for receding hairlines and widening parts and do not affect hair growth.
claims: Concealer powder can make a thinning hairline look fuller
Concealer is undetectable up close

name: Thickening spray
summary: Fatter-looking strands until the next wash.
lead: Thickening sprays are styling products applied to damp or dry hair to make strands look wider and fuller and to add volume and grip at the roots. They typically work by depositing polymers, proteins or light resins on the hair shaft, and they are aimed at fine or thinning hair. The effect is cosmetic and washes out; the products are not claimed to alter hair growth.

name: Pro clippers + edge trimmer
summary: A sharp lineup and maintained cut is a top-3 ROI purchase, period.
lead: Professional hair clippers cut hair with a fixed blade and a reciprocating blade driven by a motor, with plastic or metal guards setting the length left on the head. An edge trimmer, sometimes called a liner or T-blade trimmer, is a narrower, finer-toothed tool used to draw crisp outlines at the hairline, temples, neck and beard. Used together they let people maintain buzz cuts, fades and sharp lineups at home between barber visits .
claims: A sharp lineup and maintained cut is among the best-value grooming purchases
Clippers with a guard reduce razor-bump-style ingrown hairs compared with close shaving

name: Blow dryer + round brush
summary: Root lift and volume that flat air-drying never gives you.
lead: A blow dryer (hair dryer) is an electric device that blows warm or hot air over hair, and a round brush is a cylindrical brush used to hold hair under tension and curve as it dries. Together they are used to dry hair and to shape it, adding lift at the roots and body that air-drying does not usually give. Wikipedia explains that dryers speed up and control the formation of temporary hydrogen bonds in each strand, which give hair its shape until moisture or washing breaks them .
claims: Blow-drying with a round brush gives root lift and a fuller look
Daily blow-drying damages hair

name: Silk pillowcase
summary: Less friction on hair and skin overnight. Modest but cheap.
lead: A silk pillowcase is a pillow cover made from silk, a natural protein fiber composed mainly of fibroin with a smaller coating of sericin and most commonly obtained from the cocoons of the mulberry silkworm Bombyx mori. It is marketed in hair and skin care as a smoother alternative to cotton, with sellers claiming that lower friction overnight reduces hair breakage, frizz and sleep creases.

name: Precision beard trimmer
summary: Length control and symmetry — the foundation of every good beard.
lead: A precision beard trimmer is a compact electric hair-cutting tool with adjustable guards or a length setting, used to keep a beard at a uniform length and to tidy the cheek line and neckline. It is a smaller, finer relative of the hair clipper, which uses a stationary and a moving blade to shear hair.

name: Beard shaping guide
summary: Consistent cheek and neck lines every time.
lead: A beard shaping guide is a plastic or metal template, often with preset curves for the cheek line and neckline, held against the face as an edge to trim or shave along. Some are sold as multi-piece kits. Its purpose is to give repeatable, symmetrical lines without relying on eyeballing in a mirror.

name: Safety razor
summary: Closer shave, fewer ingrowns than cartridge razors for many.
lead: A safety razor is a razor in which a thin replaceable blade, usually double-edged, is clamped in a reusable handle behind a guard that limits how far the edge contacts the skin. It succeeded the open straight razor and preceded modern multi-blade cartridges, and is favored by wet-shaving hobbyists, for example on forums such as Badger & Blade.
claims: Wet shaving gives a closer, less irritating shave than dry shaving
Double-edge or single-blade razors suit thick beards better than cartridge razors
Shaving with the grain first, then more slowly against it, minimises bumps
An alum block and aftershave after shaving reduce irritation

name: Beard oil
summary: Softens and conditions; fixes the scratchy look.
lead: Beard oil is a cosmetic blend of carrier oils, such as jojoba, argan, sweet almond or coconut, usually with small amounts of essential oils for scent, applied to the beard and the skin beneath it. It is used to soften coarse hair, reduce dryness and itch (sometimes called beardruff) and add shine.

name: Beard balm
summary: Shape and flyaway control that holds all day.
lead: Beard balm is a thick grooming product made from butters and beeswax, often with oils, applied to a clean beard to condition it and hold its shape. Users apply it to tame flyaways and define the outline. It does not alter growth.

name: Heated beard straightener
summary: Turns wiry chaos into a deliberate beard.
lead: A heated beard straightener is a heated comb or flat-iron style tool that is pulled through facial hair to flatten wiry or curly strands and give a smoother, shaped result, mostly on longer beards.

name: Beard dye
summary: Evens patchy color, hides gray.
lead: Beard dye is a temporary, semi-permanent or permanent coloring product for facial hair, used to cover gray hairs or even out patchy color. Types include quick-wash gels, brush-on formulas and dye-free fillers.

name: Brow tweezers + scissors
summary: Clean brows change the whole eye area. Don’t over-pluck.
lead: Brow tweezers and small grooming scissors are hand tools used to shape the eyebrows. Tweezers grip individual hairs and pull them out, typically to remove strays below, between or above the brow line, while small scissors trim hairs that grow longer than the rest. Tweezers are among the oldest grooming implements, with archaeological finds from ancient Egypt, Mesopotamia and Rome.

name: Brow tint kit
summary: Darker brows read as denser brows.
lead: A brow tint kit is a product containing a semi-permanent dye and an oxidizing developer that colours eyebrow hairs, and usually the skin beneath them, for several weeks. It is used to make pale, sparse or greying brows look darker and denser. Tints are offered as a salon or brow-bar service and as home kits.

name: Brow lamination kit
summary: Redirects brow hairs up and out for weeks.
lead: A brow lamination kit is a set of chemical solutions that relaxes the keratin bonds in eyebrow hairs so they can be brushed upward and outward and held in a uniform, fluffy direction. The process is comparable to a hair perm. Results are commonly said to last about four to six weeks. Lamination is sold as a salon service and as at-home kits.

name: Clear brow gel
summary: Holds the shape all day. Cheapest item on this list that people notice.
lead: Clear brow gel is a light, usually colourless styling product brushed through the eyebrows to hold hairs in a chosen direction. Formulas typically rely on a film-forming polymer, and some add fibres or wax for texture. It is used for a groomed, uniform brow without adding colour.
